item.title: Jared Petteys Drops Blues Rock Single “Pass The Bottle”
item.description: Singer and guitarist Jared Petteys on Friday released his new blues rock song, “Pass The Bottle.” It is available on all major streaming platforms.

item.title: VA announces location of new South Carolina clinic
item.description: The Ralph H. Johnson VA Health Care System (RHJ HCS) today announced approval to construct a new community-based outpatient clinic in Port Royal, S.C.

item.title: Queso for Clayson: Home Team BBQ Helps Raise Money for Blood Cancer Research
item.description: Home Team BBQ has launched a new initiative that combines their love for community with a meaningful cause that’s deeply personal to the HT family.

item.title: The Reckoning returns to Palmetto Park Jam on March 8
item.description: Kick back and let the good vibes roll in – Palmetto Park Jam is back on Sunday, March 8 at Palmetto Islands County Park! Experience the magic of the Grateful Dead as the tribute band The Reckoning returns to headline this concert in the park.

item.title: Goose Soars Into North Charleston With Two-Night Stand at Firefly Distillery
item.description: Connecticut-based rock quartet Goose will bring its Summer 2026 tour to Firefly Distillery in North Charleston for two nights, June 23 and June 24. Tickets are on sale now.

item.title: Charleston Author Releases First Book of 2026 - A Consumer Advisory for the Horse Industry
item.description: Charleston author, Rob Liotti, has released his first book of 2026 with a consumer advisory for the national horse industry entitled, "The Consumer Guide to Horse Ownership and Purchase" published by Equine Consumer Limited

item.title: Dorchester County Encourages Residents to Stay Off Roadways During Winter Storm
item.description: Dorchester County Emergency Management officials continue to monitor weather conditions and work closely with the National Weather Services for the expected weather impacts this weekend.

item.title: Charleston County Provides Third Winter Weather Update
item.description: At 1 p.m. today, Charleston County shifted to OPCON 2 and activated the Emergency Operations Center with personnel managing the county’s response to the winter storm.

item.title: Commentary: “Smiling Faces. Beautiful Places” …. if you don’t breathe the air!
item.description: Usually when you visit South Carolina your only setbacks are hot, humid weather, your iced tea has 500 calories of sweetener, you can’t get into most of the top restaurants unless you booked LONG before you planned your trip

item.title: How Sports Themes Are Integrated into Casino Slots: What to Try
item.description: Sport has a significant influence over other forms of entertainment, and casino games are no exception. The synergy between them is not new – it has formed for decades since the emergence of the first slots. Still, the rapid growth of online gambling has allowed these two worlds to intertwine in an innovative way. In this post, we will consider how sports themes are integrated into casino slots, combining the vibrancy of competitive events with the excitement of spinning reels.
